description: This file is a shell script used for managing WLAN services, including starting, stopping, and restarting wireless interfaces and associated daemons. It contains functions for stopping and restarting WLAN, interacting with system configuration and event management tools.

methods.name: service_stop
methods.description: Stops the WLAN service by bringing down interfaces, stopping daemons, and updating system states.

methods.name: service_restart
methods.description: Restarts the WLAN service by bringing interfaces up with their previous states, restarting daemons, and updating system states.
